subject: Pricing request: multi-region rates & data residency
messages:
From: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@acme.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-02-18T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Pricing overview and EU adders

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Procurement asked me to gather a concise rate card and clarification on any region-based surcharges / data residency adders for Redwood's hosted API. Specifically:

- Baseline hosted API rates (per 1k tokens generated + embeddings) for US vs EU.
- Flat or percentage surcharge for EU-hosted inference / data residency (if any).
- Any per-GB or per-TB storage or egress adders tied to residency.
- Committed volume discount tiers and if they apply uniformly across regions.

We are evaluating a pilot that will be ~10M tokens/month and store ~2TB of cached KV-residency data in EU for 6 months. Can you send the rate card and a short worked example of expected monthly spend with and without an EU add-on?

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Jensen
Head of AI Programs, Acme Corporation
procurement@acme.com

[Attachment: ACME_Pilot_SOW.docx (DOCX, 42KB)]

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@acme.com>
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-02-18T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing overview and EU adders

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear summary. I've attached our Q1 rate card and a short EU adders worksheet for the residency scenario you described. High level: 

- Baseline hosted API (public): $0.004 / 1k prompt tokens; $0.01 / 1k completion tokens; embeddings $0.0008 / vector (example).
- EU hosting surcharge: +10% on per-token base for requests routed to EU regions (to cover cross-region infra and enterprise compliance).
- EU data residency adder: $150 / TB / month for encrypted KV/cache residency, includes audit logs and retention controls.
- Committed volume discounts: 5% at 5M tokens/mo, 10% at 20M tokens/mo, 18% at 100M tokens/mo — these apply to baseline rates before region surcharge.

Worked example (your pilot estimate):
- 10M tokens / month (assume 60% completion tokens): baseline token cost ~ $ (calc in attached sheet). With EU surcharge +10% and residency for 2TB -> residency = $300 / month.

Two quick asks so I can firm up a formal quote: your 10M token estimate: is that total combined prompt+completion tokens or just prompts? And do you expect sustained 2TB stored KV for the 6 months or peak-only?

Attaching: Redwood_RateCard_Q1_2026.pdf; EU_data_residency_adders.xlsx (workbook with calc).

If you're comfortable, I can propose a pilot quote with a 7% one-year committed discount for a 6-month pilot (to bridge evaluation-stage ARR uncertainty). Looping in Vivek for any special approval.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
[Attachment: Redwood_RateCard_Q1_2026.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

From: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@acme.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-02-18T13:45:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Pricing overview and EU adders

Marissa — thanks, that helps. A couple clarifications:

1) Tokens: 10M is total generated tokens (prompt + completion) across the month. We expect the split ~55/45 prompt/completion.
2) Residency: we'll need sustained 2TB KV storage in EU for the pilot, not just peak.

On discounts: procurement would prefer a minimum 10% committed discount if we can commit 6 months at the pilot volume. Is Redwood able to do a short-term committed tier (6 months) at 10% for pilots? Also, can you confirm whether the EU surcharge is applied after or before the committed discount (i.e., discount on base only or on base+surcharge)?

Lastly, can you confirm whether egress from EU to our US analytics cluster has separate egress fees? We may funnel logs to our US systems for evaluation.

Best,
Sarah

[Quoted text hidden]

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Cc:
Date: 2026-02-18T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Pricing overview and EU adders — approval request

Vivek / Lauren — FYI and quick ask. Acme (Sarah Jensen) is running a 6-month pilot estimate at ~10M tokens/mo and needs sustained 2TB KV residency in EU. Procurement is pushing for a 10% committed discount for the 6-month pilot (they said procurement requires that to sign). My proposed offer: 

- Approve a 6-month, pilot-specific 10% discount on baseline rates (table in attached sheet).
- EU surcharge remains +10% applied after discount? My read: we typically apply discount to baseline then add region surcharge; need sign-off either way.
- For residency, charge $150/TB/month -> $300/mo for 2TB (standard).
- Egress: standard cloud egress fees apply; for short pilots we can offer to waive cross-region egress for logs up to 1TB/month (to remove friction).

If we approve 10% and waive up to 1TB egress for the pilot, I expect them to accept. Approvals needed: 1) Vivek (commercial approval) 2) Lauren (legal on the 6-month custom term + waiver).

Attachments: EU_data_residency_adders.xlsx, Redwood_RateCard_Q1_2026.pdf (see calculations).

Thanks — Marissa

[Attachment: EU_data_residency_adders.xlsx (XLSX, 8KB)]

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-02-19T09:20:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Pricing overview and EU adders

Hi Sarah — quick update after internal review: happy to confirm the pilot proposal and pricing with the following final terms:

- Baseline rates: (confirming previously sent) $0.004 / 1k prompt tokens; $0.01 / 1k completion tokens.
- Committed pilot discount: 10% off baseline for a 6-month commitment at the pilot volume (applies to baseline token rates).
- EU region surcharge: applied after discount at +10% (i.e., (baseline * (1 - discount)) * 1.10).
- Data residency (KV/cache): $150 / TB / month -> $300 / month for 2TB (included audit logs / retention controls).
- Egress: standard cloud egress applies for EU->US; Redwood will waive up to 1TB/month of cross-region egress for the pilot period. Any overage billed at standard egress rates (see rate card).

I've attached an updated one-page quote PDF and a DocuSign link for the 6-month pilot SOW with these terms. If you approve, sign the DocuSign and we'll spin up EU-residency on day 1 of the pilot.

Quote highlights:
- Estimated monthly cost (after 10% discount, with EU surcharge and 2TB residency): $ (see attached calc)
- No upfront commitment beyond 6 months; after pilot we can discuss annual reserved capacity pricing if you want predictable throughput/cost.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/placeholder-acme-rdw-quote
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/7654321

Let me know if you'd like a short call to walk the numbers. Happy to get this turned around today.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
[Attachments: Redwood_RateCard_Q1_2026.pdf (updated, 125KB); SOW_Acme_6mo_pilot.pdf (PDF, 42KB)]
